summary: My property box are delighted to welcome to the market this two bedroom mid terrace house located on Bavington Drive, Fenham. Ideally located for local schools, good transport links in and out of the city centre with direct road routes to Newcastle International Airport.
description: There is also an array of local shops, supermarket and petrol station also close by. Externally there is a small front garden bounded by wooden fencing with mature shrubbery and to the rear a generous lawned garden.
